desc: Read N, M, Q from stdin.
For i=1..M, read S_i, T_i; set `even[i] = 1` if `abs(S_i - T_i) % 2 == 0`, else `0`.
For each of the Q queries, read L, R; compute `total = pref[R] - pref[L-1]`, `cnt = R-L+1`; if `total == cnt` print "Yes", else print "No".
Understand the core observation: a single global alternating assignment (+1 on odd edges, −1 on even edges) satisfies all even-length intervals, so feasibility reduces to all distances being even.
Plan to use O(N+M+Q) time and O(M) memory.
